description:
Uncle John Financial explains retirement money decisions simply, clearly, and with care.

This channel is for older Americans who want to understand the choices that matter most in retirement - Social Security timing, retirement income, taxes, Medicare costs, and the mistakes that quietly cost people money.

How these videos are made:
"Uncle John" is the name of this channel, not a person and not a financial adviser.
Narration: synthetic voice, directed by Ajit S.
Research, script, sourcing and editing: the Uncle John Financial team under the guidance of A.R.Khole 
Visuals: illustrations and motion graphics created and enhanced with AI tools.

To get in touch : creativegk25@gmail.com

Disclaimer: This channel is educational only and is not financial, tax, or legal advice. Uncle John Financial is not a registered investment advisor. National averages are not your numbers - consult a qualified professional before you act.
